name: Galleonaire
description: Take on the original Galleonaire handheld challenge on iPhone and Apple Watch. Answer fifteen increasingly difficult questions for a fictional million-galleon prize. The original 300-question collection explores magical books and their film adaptations, with explanations and source notes. Use Fifty-Fifty, Ask the Audience and Swap Question, protect your guaranteed prizes, or walk away with your winnings. Both devices support independent offline games, a saved highest prize, native VoiceOver controls, adjustable original music, distinct sound effects and haptics. Each fresh app launch returns to the main menu without restoring an unfinished game. This is an independent fan-made quiz, not affiliated with or endorsed by the authors, publishers or film studios referenced. Galleons are fictional points with no monetary value. No advertising or analytics.
whatToTest: Game, How to play and Settings bottom tabs, with original emerald-and-gold artwork and clear prize progress. Answer once to reveal the result immediately: no locking or confirmation. VoiceOver should move to the top result and read correct/incorrect, the correct answer and explanation together, followed by Next Question. Test Main Menu after losing or walking away. Closing and relaunching the app must discard the unfinished game and open the main menu while keeping the highest prize and settings; changing tabs must keep the running game. Fifty-Fifty removes two buttons completely. Audience percentages are inside each remaining answer; Swap Question replaces the question at the same prize level. Music and effects use their full 0-100 percent range, including with VoiceOver, with individual Settings preview buttons for all nine game cues. Listen for distinct success/failure sounds, audience applause, two Fifty-Fifty pops and the swap effect. Test iPhone and Watch, visual layouts at your chosen text size, audio interruptions, all prize milestones and paired settings sync. Physical VoiceOver and speaker testing remains important; report question errors with their source notes.
reviewNotes: No account, password, purchase, advertising or external service is needed to play. Start with New Game. The Watch app is embedded in the iPhone build and is playable independently. In-game galleons are fictional score points, not money, gambling or redeemable prizes. The app does not request Health, contacts, location, microphone or tracking access. Review both visual and native VoiceOver gameplay. Third-party book and film references are inherited trivia content; artwork and audio are original and the app makes no claim of official franchise affiliation.
